financial_anchor.value: $4.368bn revenue, up 8.7%; adjusted EPS $3.15; R&DS backlog $34.2bn with $9.2bn expected to convert in twelve months
financial_anchor.caveat: Reported/adjusted measures differ; cycle, mix and capital intensity confound.

ai_claim.claim: Healthcare-grade AI can assist site selection, patient matching, document review and trial monitoring.
ai_claim.scope: Specific workflow only; infrastructure demand is separated from own productivity.
ai_claim.limitation: No representative controlled cohort or retained-cash reconciliation.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Bookings and backlog are not realized margin, sponsor biotech funding can change quickly, and privacy/contract restrictions limit pooled learning from patient/customer data.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Does not itself disprove the scoped mechanism.

rights_limit: Public terms do not prove universal training or pooled cross-customer reuse; enterprise schedules were unavailable.
materiality_summary: Framework convention: $380m, an illustrative 5% of roughly $7.6bn annualized adjusted EBITDA scale implied by H1 commentary. Illustrative assumptions produce negative $34.8m, below the hurdle.

arithmetic.inputs: pool $6.0bn eligible clinical-operations and information-service labor/cost; efficiency 12%; realization 40%; retained share 40%; recurring cost $150m
arithmetic.formula: eligible cost × efficiency × realization × retained share − recurring AI expense

g2_provisional: Watch/incomplete: E1–E2 route exists; no E3 quality-adjusted proof or E4 cash.
